note: Quick Tap (teen numbers plus ones, no carry, pure digits). English only. Teaching has no question, so nothing to self-answer; the 1s pauses are beats before the next action. Type A (tap) = a*_q, one equation and three number keys. Type B (wrong) = the single shared find_wrong line, three number sentences with exactly one wrong. Type C (flash) = c*_q, five-second timer bar and three number keys. Runtime shuffles the ten questions and every option set.

lines.text: Look at the blocks. One ten and three ones. That's thirteen.
Now, we see the numbers. Ten plus three equals thirteen.
Let's add the ones. Two plus five equals seven.
One ten and seven ones make seventeen.
Fourteen plus three. Tap the right answer.
Eleven plus five. Tap the right answer.
Thirteen plus five. Tap the right answer.
Twelve plus seven. Tap the right answer.
Quick! Eleven plus six equals what?
Quick! Thirteen plus six equals what?
Quick! Fourteen plus four equals what?
